notes: Not the pick, 2026-11-17: he asked for the largest on wheels and left the choice to the designer ("pick for me ... I prefer larger ove rsmall"; "wheels are mandatory"), and the pick is Yaheetech's 46 x 22" island (amazon-B0C8N5JH8H). Still a line in his Amazon cart when last read, his to remove. In Andrew's Amazon cart, qty 1, read 2026-11-17 ("I got 2 in my amazon cart, review and find better one"): his pick under review, not a decision. Andrew, 2026-11-17: "I want a floating kitchen island. Place on the wall opposite side of wall of where the living room console is (in the kitchen is where I will put it)." Slot: the kitchen face of the 51" wall whose living-room face holds the Decofy console (F-20); taken as the same 51" on the kitchen side, untaped. The kitchen is not measured, so the walkway in front of the piece (F-30: 30" at least, 36" preferred; 42" where it faces the range, sink or fridge, the designer's standard) is unchecked until Andrew tapes from that wall to whatever faces it. Fit: 43.3" overall leaves 7.7" of the 51"; 17.7" deep; 32.5 to 32.7" tall, about 3 1/2" under a 36" counter, so an adult stoops to chop on it. Two drawers, four doors, adjustable shelves, a spice rack and a towel bar; four lockable swivel casters. Top: solid rubberwood, 1" thick; body: MDF ("Solid Rubberwood & MDF"). 4.3 stars (1,337): 5 star 66%, 1 star 7%; Amazon's summary of the reviews: mixed on assembly and sturdiness, pieces breaking during assembly, unclear picture-only instructions; buyers on the listing report 3 to 5 hours to build and a thin back panel. Amazon's Choice; 200+ bought in past month; typical price $155.99; ships from and sold by Amazon.com; returnable until Jan 31, 2027; FREE delivery Thursday, November 19. The same listing has other sizes, not read: 42.4"W, and drop-leaf versions at 35.4, 42.4, 45.3, 47.6 and 60". Review, 2026-11-17: the better of his two (a real wood top, sold by Amazon, seven times the ratings), held back by its height. Flags: none from the vocabulary; the walkway is unchecked. rooms: the brief.
